# mergeah_tool_call_logs (Data Source)

Read Merge Agent Handler tool_call_logs. Results are available as JSON via response_json; paginated collections are fetched completely.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
data "mergeah_tool_call_logs" "example" {
}

locals {
  tool_call_logs = jsondecode(data.mergeah_tool_call_logs.example.response_json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `client_trace_id` (String) Merge API field `client_trace_id`.
- `connector_id` (String) Merge API field `connector_id`.
- `created_after` (String) Merge API field `created_after`.
- `created_before` (String) Merge API field `created_before`.
- `error_reason` (String) Merge API field `error_reason`.
- `query` (Map of String) Additional documented API query parameters. All pages are fetched automatically. Values must be strings.
- `status` (String) Merge API field `status`.
- `tool_name` (String) Merge API field `tool_name`.
- `turn_id` (String) Merge API field `turn_id`.

### Read-Only

- `response_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object for a detail endpoint, or JSON array containing every item for a collection. Use jsondecode to read fields. Sensitive because API records may contain personal data.
